title: Broadcast from the Void
logline: A journalist hires a pilot to repair a massive comms relay drifting in a dark zone to broadcast the truth about a corporate cover-up, but bounty hunters are lurking in the silence to stop them.

roles.description: Terrified, exhausted, carrying a data drive worth a thousand lives.
Never speaks on open comms. Communicates only through weapon locks.
A massive, dead communication spire floating in absolute darkness.
A stealth interceptor painted matte black.
The shadowy organization trying to silence the truth.
An auxiliary power hub attached to the relay.
A small stealth fighter screening for the hunter.

public_situation: The {role:corporate_intelligence} has declared the dark zone strictly off-limits due to 'unexploded ordnance' from a recent corporate dispute.
private_truth: There are no mines. The corporation is just hiding the only surviving comms relay powerful enough to break their sector-wide media blackout.

beats.public_change: The journalist broadcasts a short burst on an encrypted channel, begging for an escort into the dark zone.

missions.reason: The journalist needs the pilot to deliver a massive power cell to the dead relay to bring it back online.
missions.private_fact: The power cell is highly unstable and will explode if the pilot takes too much damage.

beats.public_change: The relay powers up, painting the pilot's ship with a massive EM signature in the dark.

missions.reason: The pilot must buy the sensor buoy from a local scavenger.
missions.private_fact: The hunter is using the buoy to paint targets for long-range torpedoes.

missions.reason: The pilot must turn and destroy the stealth hunter before it can launch its torpedoes.
missions.private_fact: The hunter has active camouflage, making it very hard to hit.

beats.public_change: The relay is fully charged and ready to accept the journalist's broadcast.

missions.reason: Before the broadcast can begin, the pilot must shoot the hunter's jamming pod out of the wreckage to clear the signal.
missions.private_fact: If the pod isn't destroyed, the broadcast will just be static.

player_choice.prompt: The channel is open. The pilot can upload the journalist's truth, or broadcast a corporate override code to permanently burn out the relay for a massive bounty.

resolutions.reached_by: The pilot uploads the journalist's data.
resolutions.summary: The data reveals massive corporate corruption. Riots break out, corporate intelligence is investigated, and the journalist becomes a hero.

consequences.public_summary: A pilot repaired a dead relay in a dark zone to broadcast corporate corruption across the whole sector.

resolutions.reached_by: The pilot burns out the relay.
resolutions.summary: The relay goes dark forever. The journalist is arrested by corporate hit squads, but the pilot's bank account overflows with hush money.
The stealth hunter torpedoes the journalist's ship in the dark. The truth dies in the cold void.

loose_threads.detail: The stealth hunter's torpedoes leave a radioactive signature identical to weapons used by a notorious pirate fleet.
The journalist's supposedly encrypted data drive periodically attempts to handshake with a restricted corporate internal server.

radio_hooks: Unidentified EM bursts detected originating from the dark zone.
{role:corporate_intelligence} issues warning about rogue elements broadcasting lies.

voice_direction.paranoid_journalist: Breathless, speaks very fast, trusts no one.
voice_direction.silent_hunter: Never speaks. Voice directions only apply to automated ship warnings.
